theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_vitali_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ν Ψ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (S W : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) → ℝ) (R₀ : ℝ) (M : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ y ∈ S, 0 < r y ∧ r y ≤ R₀ ∧ closedBall y (r y) ⊆ W ∧ ν (S ∩ closedBall y (5 * r y)) ≤ M * Ψ (closedBall y (r y))) → ν S ≤ M * Ψ W
